title: 新加坡濱海堤壩~Marina Barrage
focus: 都市逕流、潮位排水、抽水能源與水庫水質~Urban runoff, tidal drainage, pumping energy and reservoir water quality
summary: 本課以新加坡濱海堤壩為入口，深入都市逕流、潮位排水、抽水能源與水庫水質。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Marina Barrage as its entry point, this course examines urban runoff, tidal drainage, pumping energy and reservoir water quality. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 降雨敏感度固定集水區A=2 km²與逕流係數C=0.75，只將雨強i由60改為90 mm/h；兩情境都假設降雨歷時超過集流時間。沿用同一單位換算式Q=0.278CiA，流量由25.02增至37.53 m³/s，增加50%。此線性比較未納入C隨飽和改變或渠道滯蓄，也不是泵站所需容量的直接決定。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s, excluding channel storage. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold catchment area A=2 km² and runoff coefficient C=0.75 fixed, changing only rainfall intensity i from 60 to 90 mm/h; both storms last beyond concentration time. With the same unit-converted relation Q=0.278CiA, flow increases from 25.02 to 37.53 m³/s, or 50%. This linear comparison excludes saturation-related changes in C and channel storage and does not directly determine pumping capacity.
history: 濱海堤壩在新加坡市中心把淡水蓄存、防洪排水與公共空間結合，低潮重力排水與高潮抽水對應不同邊界條件。十月三十一日濱海堤壩正式開放，形成新加坡第十五座水庫。 水工鋼結構設計指引出版，作活動閘門的技術比較資料。 機電設計指引更新，作抽水與備援觀念的教育參照。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。~Marina Barrage combines freshwater storage, urban drainage and public space in Singapore, with different boundary conditions for low-tide gravity flow and high-tide pumping. Marina Barrage officially opens on October thirty-one, forming Singapores fifteenth reservoir. Hydraulic steel-structure guidance is published as a technical comparison for movable gates. Mechanical-electrical guidance is updated as educational context for pumping and redundancy. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

units.anchor: 集水區逕流峰值~Catchment runoff peak
units.title: 集水區逕流峰值~Catchment runoff peak
units.mechanism: 都市不透水面提高快速逕流比例，但降雨空間與集流時間控制峰值。合理化公式適合指定的小型集水區條件，不能直接代表整個大型水庫入流歷線。 假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。 短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。把每個分區峰值直接相加，可能錯估各峰不同時到達的真實入流。~Impervious surfaces increase rapid runoff, while rainfall distribution and concentration time control the peak. The rational method applies to specified small-catchment conditions, not a complete large-reservoir inflow hydrograph. Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s, excluding channel storage. Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. Adding every subcatchment peak directly can misrepresent the actual combined inflow when peaks arrive at different times.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s, excluding channel storage.
units.verify: 用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。對雨量歷時與集流時間的比值作檢查，確認峰值公式沒有用在尚未全區貢獻的短雨。~Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag. Attach land-use changes, drainage boundaries and chosen concentration time to the calculation record. Compare storm duration with concentration time to ensure the peak formula is not applied before the full catchment contributes.
units.failure: 短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。把每個分區峰值直接相加，可能錯估各峰不同時到達的真實入流。~Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. Adding every subcatchment peak directly can misrepresent the actual combined inflow when peaks arrive at different times.
units.misconception: 各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。~Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing.
units.practice: 以集水區逕流峰值編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for catchment runoff peak, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag. Attach land-use changes, drainage boundaries and chosen concentration time to the calculation record.

units.anchor: 庫容與淨入流~Storage and net inflow
units.title: 庫容與淨入流~Storage and net inflow
units.mechanism: 水庫水位變化由入流減去閘排、抽水及其他出流決定。庫面不是永遠固定，低窪岸帶開始淹沒時，水位與庫容的關係會改變。 假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。 抽水流量若採額定值而非當時揚程下的實際值，會產生虛假的未量測入流。時間步太長又可能把短時高峰平滑掉，低估岸邊淹水機會。~Reservoir level changes with inflow minus gravity discharge, pumping and other losses. Surface area is not always constant; inundating low banks changes the stage-storage relation. Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate. Using rated pump discharge instead of flow at actual head creates false unexplained inflow. Long time steps smooth brief peaks and can underestimate opportunities for flooding along the reservoir edge.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate.
units.verify: 將每個流量來源按相同時間步積分，對照實測庫容變化；檢查水位站是否受局部風浪或排水噴流影響，再辨認水量平衡殘差。縮短積分時間步再做水量閉合，檢查估算最大水位是否隨解析度提高而穩定。~Integrate each flow source on identical time steps and compare measured storage change. Check gauges for local waves or discharge jets before interpreting the water-balance residual. Repeat storage closure with shorter integration steps and check whether maximum estimated level converges as resolution improves.
units.failure: 抽水流量若採額定值而非當時揚程下的實際值，會產生虛假的未量測入流。時間步太長又可能把短時高峰平滑掉，低估岸邊淹水機會。~Using rated pump discharge instead of flow at actual head creates false unexplained inflow. Long time steps smooth brief peaks and can underestimate opportunities for flooding along the reservoir edge.
units.misconception: 水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。~An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow.
units.practice: 以庫容與淨入流編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將每個流量來源按相同時間步積分，對照實測庫容變化；檢查水位站是否受局部風浪或排水噴流影響，再辨認水量平衡殘差。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for storage and net inflow, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate each flow source on identical time steps and compare measured storage change. Check gauges for local waves or discharge jets before interpreting the water-balance residual.

units.anchor: 低潮重力排水~Low-tide gravity drainage
units.title: 低潮重力排水~Low-tide gravity drainage
units.mechanism: 庫水高於海水時可由水頭差驅動排水，潮位反轉則可能失去這項能力。閘口流況隨上下游淹沒程度改變，單一係數不能代表全部潮相。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設有效孔口20 m²、Cd=0.65、水頭差0.5 m；Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=40.72 m³/s，限淹沒孔口準穩定流。 水頭接近零時儀器偏差可能比真實差值更大，造成錯判流向。忽略海側波浪與回流時，即使平均水頭為正，也不能保證瞬間全向外排水。~A positive reservoir-to-sea head can drive gravity drainage, but tidal reversal removes it. Opening hydraulics vary with downstream submergence, so one coefficient does not describe every tide. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume effective opening 20 m², Cd=0.65 and head difference 0.5 m. Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=40.72 m³/s, for quasi-steady submerged-orifice flow. Near zero head, instrument bias may exceed the real difference and reverse the inferred direction. Waves and return currents can create inward flow even with positive mean outward head.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設有效孔口20 m²、Cd=0.65、水頭差0.5 m；Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=40.72 m³/s，限淹沒孔口準穩定流。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume effective opening 20 m², Cd=0.65 and head difference 0.5 m. Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=40.72 m³/s, for quasi-steady submerged-orifice flow.
units.verify: 同步核對內外水位、開口面積及流向，將資料分成淹沒與自由出流型態；以實測流量校正係數，並保留潮位快速變化期間的偏差。以雙向流量資料核對接近零水頭時的符號，量化水位零點偏差可能造成的判斷範圍。~Synchronize internal and external levels, opening area and flow direction. Separate submerged and free-outflow regimes, calibrate coefficients with measured discharge and retain rapid-tide residuals. Check near-zero-head direction against bidirectional flow data and quantify the ambiguity caused by gauge-zero offsets.
units.failure: 水頭接近零時儀器偏差可能比真實差值更大，造成錯判流向。忽略海側波浪與回流時，即使平均水頭為正，也不能保證瞬間全向外排水。~Near zero head, instrument bias may exceed the real difference and reverse the inferred direction. Waves and return currents can create inward flow even with positive mean outward head.
units.misconception: 平均庫位高於海面就保證所有瞬間都向海排水。~A higher mean reservoir level guarantees outward flow at every instant.
units.practice: 以低潮重力排水編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步核對內外水位、開口面積及流向，將資料分成淹沒與自由出流型態；以實測流量校正係數，並保留潮位快速變化期間的偏差。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for low-tide gravity drainage, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Synchronize internal and external levels, opening area and flow direction. Separate submerged and free-outflow regimes, calibrate coefficients with measured discharge and retain rapid-tide residuals.

units.anchor: 高平均潮位抽水~Pumping against elevated tide
units.title: 高平均潮位抽水~Pumping against elevated tide
units.mechanism: 抽水把水量提升到較高海側水位，需要克服靜揚程和管路損失。功率隨流量與揚程變化，不能用固定每立方公尺能耗描述所有潮況。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設淡水Q=20 m³/s、總揚程3 m、總效率0.8；輸入P=ρgQH/η=735.75 kW，不含啟動電流或備援負載。 揚程增加可能使泵流量下降，同時改變效率與振動。只看設備已通電會高估排水能力；忽略輔助設備能耗也會低估整場暴雨的能源需求。~Pumping lifts water against sea level and conveyance losses. Power varies with both flow and head, so a fixed energy per cubic metre cannot describe all tidal conditions. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume fresh-water flow 20 m³/s, total head 3 m and overall efficiency 0.8. Input P=ρgQH/η=735.75 kW, excluding starting current and auxiliary backup loads. Increasing head may reduce pump flow while changing efficiency and vibration. Energized equipment does not establish drainage capacity, and omitting auxiliary loads understates energy required for the complete storm event.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設淡水Q=20 m³/s、總揚程3 m、總效率0.8；輸入P=ρgQH/η=735.75 kW，不含啟動電流或備援負載。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume fresh-water flow 20 m³/s, total head 3 m and overall efficiency 0.8. Input P=ρgQH/η=735.75 kW, excluding starting current and auxiliary backup loads.
units.verify: 核對泵前後壓力、流量與電表，分列靜揚程和沿程損失；把效率對應到實際工況，不能以最佳效率點替代高海潮期間的效率。以電功率扣除輔助負載後核對效率曲線，確認流量與揚程量測時間完全對齊。~Compare suction and delivery pressure, flow and metered electricity. Separate static head from line loss and use efficiency at the actual operating point rather than the best-efficiency value during high tide. Remove auxiliary electrical demand before checking efficiency curves and ensure head and discharge measurements are time-aligned.
units.failure: 揚程增加可能使泵流量下降，同時改變效率與振動。只看設備已通電會高估排水能力；忽略輔助設備能耗也會低估整場暴雨的能源需求。~Increasing head may reduce pump flow while changing efficiency and vibration. Energized equipment does not establish drainage capacity, and omitting auxiliary loads understates energy required for the complete storm event.
units.misconception: 抽水機已經運轉就表示一定達到額定排水流量。~A running pump necessarily delivers its rated drainage flow.
units.practice: 以高平均潮位抽水編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對泵前後壓力、流量與電表，分列靜揚程和沿程損失；把效率對應到實際工況，不能以最佳效率點替代高海潮期間的效率。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for pumping against elevated tide, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare suction and delivery pressure, flow and metered electricity. Separate static head from line loss and use efficiency at the actual operating point rather than the best-efficiency value during high tide.

units.anchor: 並聯泵與系統曲線~Parallel pumps and system curve
units.title: 並聯泵與系統曲線~Parallel pumps and system curve
units.mechanism: 並聯泵共享同一出水系統，增加機組會提高管損，單機工作點也移動。因此兩台流量不是把單台自由出水流量直接相加。 曲線採H以m、q與Q以m³/s表示；截距10、2的單位為m，係數0.01、0.005的單位均為s²/m⁵。假設單泵H=10−0.01q²、系統H=2+0.005Q²，兩泵相同且Q=2q；解得Q=√(8/0.0075)=32.66 m³/s。 兩台老化程度不同會造成不均分流，甚至低流量機組接近不穩定區。忽略共用管損的加倍估算，通常會高估新增泵帶來的容量提升。~Parallel pumps share a discharge system. Adding units increases losses and shifts each operating point, so combined flow is not simply twice a single pump free-discharge rate. For these dimensional curves H is in m and q and Q are in m³/s. Intercepts 10 and 2 have units m; coefficients 0.01 and 0.005 both have units s²/m⁵. Assume each pump H=10−0.01q² and system H=2+0.005Q², with two identical pumps Q=2q. Solving gives Q=√(8/0.0075)=32.66 m³/s. Unequal ageing creates unequal sharing and may place one unit near an unstable low-flow region. Doubling capacity while ignoring shared losses typically overstates the benefit of adding another pump.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：曲線採H以m、q與Q以m³/s表示；截距10、2的單位為m，係數0.01、0.005的單位均為s²/m⁵。假設單泵H=10−0.01q²、系統H=2+0.005Q²，兩泵相同且Q=2q；解得Q=√(8/0.0075)=32.66 m³/s。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: For these dimensional curves H is in m and q and Q are in m³/s. Intercepts 10 and 2 have units m; coefficients 0.01 and 0.005 both have units s²/m⁵. Assume each pump H=10−0.01q² and system H=2+0.005Q², with two identical pumps Q=2q. Solving gives Q=√(8/0.0075)=32.66 m³/s.
units.verify: 將單泵曲線換成共同總流量座標，與系統曲線交點比較實測揚程；逐台核對流量分配與逆止閥狀態，避免只看總出水量。以逐台投入的穩定工況重建系統阻力係數，檢查兩台流量分配是否符合各自泵曲線。~Convert individual pump curves to a common total-flow axis and compare the intersection with measured head. Check individual sharing and check-valve behavior instead of relying only on total discharge. Reconstruct system resistance from staged steady operation and check each pump share against its own performance curve.
units.failure: 兩台老化程度不同會造成不均分流，甚至低流量機組接近不穩定區。忽略共用管損的加倍估算，通常會高估新增泵帶來的容量提升。~Unequal ageing creates unequal sharing and may place one unit near an unstable low-flow region. Doubling capacity while ignoring shared losses typically overstates the benefit of adding another pump.
units.misconception: 並聯兩台相同泵的總流量必定是單台的兩倍。~Two identical parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow.
units.practice: 以並聯泵與系統曲線編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將單泵曲線換成共同總流量座標，與系統曲線交點比較實測揚程；逐台核對流量分配與逆止閥狀態，避免只看總出水量。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for parallel pumps and system curve, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Convert individual pump curves to a common total-flow axis and compare the intersection with measured head. Check individual sharing and check-valve behavior instead of relying only on total discharge.

units.anchor: 汽蝕餘裕與吸水~Cavitation margin and suction
units.title: 汽蝕餘裕與吸水~Cavitation margin and suction
units.mechanism: 吸水側壓力若接近水的汽化壓，氣泡形成與崩潰會傷害葉片。淨正吸入水頭需使用絕對壓力，且和廠商所定試驗條件分開比較。 假設大氣水頭10.3 m、吸水靜高1.5 m、吸管損失0.8 m、汽化水頭0.3 m，NPSHa=10.3+1.5−0.8−0.3=10.7 m。 低水位與堵塞會同時降低可用吸入水頭，吸入空氣也會產生類似汽蝕的噪音。以冷水汽化壓代表熱天水況，可能誇大實際餘裕。~Vapor bubbles form and collapse when suction pressure approaches vapor pressure, damaging impellers. Available net positive suction head uses absolute pressure and must be compared with the manufacturer test definition. Assume atmospheric head 10.3 m, positive suction static head 1.5 m, suction loss 0.8 m and vapor head 0.3 m. NPSHa=10.3+1.5−0.8−0.3=10.7 m. Low level and blockage both reduce available suction head, while entrained air can imitate cavitation noise. Using cold-water vapor pressure for warm conditions may exaggerate the available margin.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設大氣水頭10.3 m、吸水靜高1.5 m、吸管損失0.8 m、汽化水頭0.3 m，NPSHa=10.3+1.5−0.8−0.3=10.7 m。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume atmospheric head 10.3 m, positive suction static head 1.5 m, suction loss 0.8 m and vapor head 0.3 m. NPSHa=10.3+1.5−0.8−0.3=10.7 m.
units.verify: 記錄水溫、水位與吸口壓力，核對入口旋渦和攔污柵堵塞；將振動、噪音與效率變化一起判讀，避免把任一聲音直接認定為汽蝕。將最低吸水位和最高水溫的證據並列，確認吸入空氣與汽化空泡已用不同訊號辨識。~Record temperature, water level and suction pressure, checking intake vortices and screen blockage. Interpret vibration, noise and efficiency together instead of identifying cavitation from sound alone. Compare minimum suction level with maximum water temperature and distinguish entrained air from vapor cavities using separate evidence.
units.failure: 低水位與堵塞會同時降低可用吸入水頭，吸入空氣也會產生類似汽蝕的噪音。以冷水汽化壓代表熱天水況，可能誇大實際餘裕。~Low level and blockage both reduce available suction head, while entrained air can imitate cavitation noise. Using cold-water vapor pressure for warm conditions may exaggerate the available margin.
units.misconception: 沒有明顯噪音就足以證明吸水條件有足夠餘裕。~Absence of obvious noise proves sufficient suction-head margin.
units.practice: 以汽蝕餘裕與吸水編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。記錄水溫、水位與吸口壓力，核對入口旋渦和攔污柵堵塞；將振動、噪音與效率變化一起判讀，避免把任一聲音直接認定為汽蝕。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cavitation margin and suction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record temperature, water level and suction pressure, checking intake vortices and screen blockage. Interpret vibration, noise and efficiency together instead of identifying cavitation from sound alone.

units.anchor: 鹽水入侵質量平衡~Salt intrusion mass balance
units.title: 鹽水入侵質量平衡~Salt intrusion mass balance
units.mechanism: 淡水庫的鹽度受微量海水入侵影響，鹽水密度較大會先沿底部擴散。平均混合模型只能估算總鹽量，不能代表取水口短時濃度。 假設淡水體積1 million m³、混入1000 m³海水鹽度35 g/kg，同密度完全混合；平均鹽度35×1000/1001000=0.03497 g/kg。 稀釋後平均值很低仍可能有高鹽舌接近取水口，風浪混合也可能突然把底水抬升。只在表層採樣，會誤認鹽水已完全排除。~Small seawater intrusions affect a freshwater reservoir, and denser water can spread along the bottom first. A mean-mixing model estimates total salt but not short-term intake concentration. Assume freshwater volume 1 million m³ and intrusion 1000 m³ at 35 g/kg, equal densities and complete mixing. Mean salinity is 35×1000/1001000=0.03497 g/kg. A low diluted mean can coexist with a saline tongue near an intake. Wind mixing may suddenly lift bottom water, while surface-only sampling can falsely suggest intrusion has been removed.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淡水體積1 million m³、混入1000 m³海水鹽度35 g/kg，同密度完全混合；平均鹽度35×1000/1001000=0.03497 g/kg。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume freshwater volume 1 million m³ and intrusion 1000 m³ at 35 g/kg, equal densities and complete mixing. Mean salinity is 35×1000/1001000=0.03497 g/kg.
units.verify: 沿庫底至取水口布設深度剖面，校正電導與溫度，再以水量平衡核對入侵總量；保留底層尖峰而非只輸出全庫平均。用底層鹽度時序估算前緣移動，核對取水口短時峰值是否被全庫平均值掩蓋。~Profile depth from the bed to the intake, calibrating conductivity and temperature. Check intrusion volume against water balance and preserve bottom-layer peaks rather than reporting only a reservoir average. Estimate front movement from bottom-salinity histories and check whether the reservoir mean conceals brief intake peaks.
units.failure: 稀釋後平均值很低仍可能有高鹽舌接近取水口，風浪混合也可能突然把底水抬升。只在表層採樣，會誤認鹽水已完全排除。~A low diluted mean can coexist with a saline tongue near an intake. Wind mixing may suddenly lift bottom water, while surface-only sampling can falsely suggest intrusion has been removed.
units.misconception: 平均鹽度很低就表示所有深度的水質完全相同。~Low mean salinity means water quality is identical at every depth.
units.practice: 以鹽水入侵質量平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿庫底至取水口布設深度剖面，校正電導與溫度，再以水量平衡核對入侵總量；保留底層尖峰而非只輸出全庫平均。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for salt intrusion mass balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Profile depth from the bed to the intake, calibrating conductivity and temperature. Check intrusion volume against water balance and preserve bottom-layer peaks rather than reporting only a reservoir average.

units.anchor: 水力停留與營養鹽~Residence time and nutrients
units.title: 水力停留與營養鹽~Residence time and nutrients
units.mechanism: 停留時間影響營養鹽累積和藻類生長，但流動短路會讓部分水很快排出、其他水長期滯留。平均V/Q只是比較尺度，不能單獨預測生態反應。 假設有效庫容12 million m³、平均換水量6 m³/s，V/Q=2 million s=23.15 days；穩定完全混合近似，不代表所有水齡。 用總庫容忽略實際隔離死水區會誤判交換效率，增加出流也不必然沖走滯水。若未分離光照和水溫，不能把藻量變化全歸因於停留時間。~Residence time influences nutrients and algae, but short-circuiting releases some water quickly while other regions stagnate. Mean V/Q is a comparison scale, not a complete ecological prediction. Assume effective volume 12 million m³ and average exchange 6 m³/s. V/Q=2 million s=23.15 days, a steady complete-mixing approximation rather than every parcel age. Ignoring isolated stagnant zones misjudges exchange, and more outflow need not flush them. Without separating light and temperature, changes in algae cannot be attributed entirely to hydraulic residence time.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效庫容12 million m³、平均換水量6 m³/s，V/Q=2 million s=23.15 days；穩定完全混合近似，不代表所有水齡。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective volume 12 million m³ and average exchange 6 m³/s. V/Q=2 million s=23.15 days, a steady complete-mixing approximation rather than every parcel age.
units.verify: 以示蹤或導電度事件比較不同灣區到達時間，連同溶氧、溫度和葉綠素建立時序；區分物理滯留與外部營養鹽負荷增加。比較示蹤首達、峰值和尾跡時間，判斷短路流與長滯留區是否同時存在。~Compare tracer or conductivity-event arrival times across reservoir arms and build oxygen, temperature and chlorophyll histories. Distinguish physical retention from increased external nutrient loading. Compare tracer first arrival, peak and tail times to determine whether short-circuiting and long-retention regions coexist.
units.failure: 用總庫容忽略實際隔離死水區會誤判交換效率，增加出流也不必然沖走滯水。若未分離光照和水溫，不能把藻量變化全歸因於停留時間。~Ignoring isolated stagnant zones misjudges exchange, and more outflow need not flush them. Without separating light and temperature, changes in algae cannot be attributed entirely to hydraulic residence time.
units.misconception: 縮短平均停留時間就能保證每個灣區都有效換水。~Shorter mean residence guarantees effective renewal in every reservoir arm.
units.practice: 以水力停留與營養鹽編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以示蹤或導電度事件比較不同灣區到達時間，連同溶氧、溫度和葉綠素建立時序；區分物理滯留與外部營養鹽負荷增加。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for residence time and nutrients, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare tracer or conductivity-event arrival times across reservoir arms and build oxygen, temperature and chlorophyll histories. Distinguish physical retention from increased external nutrient loading.

units.anchor: 攔污柵損失與堵塞~Screen losses and blockage
units.title: 攔污柵損失與堵塞~Screen losses and blockage
units.mechanism: 攔污柵保護設備卻增加水頭損失，堵塞使有效流通面積縮小。損失係數與速度必須使用相容的面積定義，否則會重複計算堵塞影響。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設通過柵格的有效速度1.5 m/s、損失係數K=2，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m；K已對應該速度定義，不再另加堵塞倍數。 堵塞不均會把水流集中到少數開口，引發局部振動與吸氣。差壓增加也可能來自流量增大，因此未正規化的趨勢不能直接當作堵塞程度。~Screens protect equipment but consume head, and blockage reduces open area. Loss coefficient and velocity must use compatible area definitions to avoid counting the blockage effect twice. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume effective screen velocity 1.5 m/s and loss coefficient K=2. hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m; K corresponds to that velocity definition, without another blockage multiplier. Uneven blockage concentrates flow through a few openings, promoting vibration and air entrainment. Increased differential head can also reflect increased flow, so an unnormalized trend does not directly measure blockage.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設通過柵格的有效速度1.5 m/s、損失係數K=2，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m；K已對應該速度定義，不再另加堵塞倍數。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume effective screen velocity 1.5 m/s and loss coefficient K=2. hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m; K corresponds to that velocity definition, without another blockage multiplier.
units.verify: 同步比較柵前後水位、流量與可見堵塞比例，建立清潔基線；檢查差壓管是否也被泥沙堵住，並將異常與雨後漂流物來源對照。將差壓除以速度平方建立清潔與堵塞曲線，確認量測差異不是單純流量增加。~Compare upstream and downstream levels, flow and visible blockage against a clean baseline. Check pressure connections for sediment blockage and relate anomalies to storm-driven debris sources. Normalize differential head by velocity squared and compare clean and blocked curves to exclude a simple increase in flow.
units.failure: 堵塞不均會把水流集中到少數開口，引發局部振動與吸氣。差壓增加也可能來自流量增大，因此未正規化的趨勢不能直接當作堵塞程度。~Uneven blockage concentrates flow through a few openings, promoting vibration and air entrainment. Increased differential head can also reflect increased flow, so an unnormalized trend does not directly measure blockage.
units.misconception: 差壓增加只可能來自攔污柵堵塞，與流量無關。~Higher screen differential head only indicates blockage and is unrelated to flow.
units.practice: 以攔污柵損失與堵塞編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步比較柵前後水位、流量與可見堵塞比例，建立清潔基線；檢查差壓管是否也被泥沙堵住，並將異常與雨後漂流物來源對照。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for screen losses and blockage, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare upstream and downstream levels, flow and visible blockage against a clean baseline. Check pressure connections for sediment blockage and relate anomalies to storm-driven debris sources.

units.anchor: 複合事件與失效組合~Compound events and failure combinations
units.title: 複合事件與失效組合~Compound events and failure combinations
units.mechanism: 暴雨、高海潮與電力限制可能同時發生，聯合機率取決於相關性。把各事件單獨罕見當成組合必定極罕見，會忽略共同氣象原因。 假設一年高海潮事件機率0.1，且該條件下強降雨機率0.3，聯合機率0.03；若誤用無條件雨率0.1獨立相乘會得到0.01。 樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。只列一個年機率而不說事件窗口，容易把短時設備容量與長期風險混為一談。~Heavy rain, high tide and power constraints can coincide, with joint probability depending on dependence. Individually rare events do not necessarily make their combination extremely rare when weather drives several conditions together. Assume annual high-tide event probability 0.1 and conditional heavy-rain probability 0.3. Joint probability is 0.03; incorrectly multiplying an unconditional rain probability 0.1 gives 0.01. Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. Reporting one annual probability without its event window confuses short-term capacity with long-term risk.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一年高海潮事件機率0.1，且該條件下強降雨機率0.3，聯合機率0.03；若誤用無條件雨率0.1獨立相乘會得到0.01。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual high-tide event probability 0.1 and conditional heavy-rain probability 0.3. Joint probability is 0.03; incorrectly multiplying an unconditional rain probability 0.1 gives 0.01.
units.verify: 明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。用相同事件時間窗口重算條件機率，並報告小樣本區間及相關性假設的敏感度。~Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year. Link storage, pump availability and power condition in a scenario matrix. Recalculate conditional probabilities with a consistent event window and report small-sample ranges and sensitivity to dependence assumptions.
units.failure: 樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。只列一個年機率而不說事件窗口，容易把短時設備容量與長期風險混為一談。~Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. Reporting one annual probability without its event window confuses short-term capacity with long-term risk.
units.misconception: 罕見暴雨和罕見高潮可以不經檢查直接視為獨立。~Rare rainfall and rare high tides can be assumed independent without checking.
units.practice: 以複合事件與失效組合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compound events and failure combinations, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year. Link storage, pump availability and power condition in a scenario matrix.
